DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路の落下物についてのお話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are calling about an object that has fallen onto the road, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 高速道路で脚立のような物が落ちていました。私は助手席で見ましたが、場所をどう伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 助手席から見た高速道路の脚立様落下物の伝達方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was something like a stepladder on the expressway. I saw it from the passenger seat. How should I describe the location?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to report a stepladder-like object seen on the expressway from the passenger seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 進んでいた方向と、近くの出入口は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which direction you were traveling and any nearby entrances or exits?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南へ向かう車線です。中央の出口を通り過ぎて、次の橋の手前でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 進行方向と出口橋の位置関係を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: We were in the southbound lanes. It was past the central exit and just before the next bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the direction of travel and its position relative to the exit and bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通った時刻と、どの車線にあったかを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me when you passed it and which lane it was in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十時五分ごろです。左の車線にあり、運転した夫が右へ移って避けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十時五分と左車線及び回避行動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was around 10:05. It was in the left lane, and my husband, who was driving, moved right to avoid it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time, 10:05, the left lane, and the action taken to avoid it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今は安全な場所へ移動されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you moved to a safe place now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口を降りて駐車場にいます。脚立を積んでいた車は見ていないので、落とした人は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 安全駐車場所と落下元未目撃を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: We took the exit and are in a parking lot. I did not see the vehicle carrying the stepladder, so I do not know who dropped it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your safe parking location and that you did not see where the object fell from. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道路を管理する担当への連絡を含めて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check, including contacting the staff responsible for managing the road.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所と時刻を伝えてください。私の車には傷がないですが、後ろの車が避けられたかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車の無傷と後続車状況不明を伝え担当連絡を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please pass on the location and time. Our car has no damage, but I did not see whether the car behind us managed to avoid it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that your car is undamaged and the following car's situation is unknown, and ask for the responsible staff to be contacted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 情報を確認して担当へ伝えます。お知らせありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the information and pass it to the responsible staff. Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending a booklet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講座の冊子を送ります。後ろに録画のディスクも付いているので、紙だけの場合と同じ方法で出せるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冊子付録ディスク込みの発送方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a course booklet. A disc with a recording is attached at the back, so I would like to ask whether I can send it the same way as paper alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending a booklet together with its supplementary disc. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ディスクはケースに入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the disc in a case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 薄いケースへ入れ、冊子の裏側の袋に差しています。袋から外れるかもしれないので、固定し直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薄ケースと外れる付録袋の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is in a thin case tucked into a pocket on the back of the booklet. It may slip out of the pocket, so I would like to secure it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the thin case and the supplementary pocket it may slip out of. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送方法と梱包を、内容に合わせてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain shipping and packaging options suited to the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ディスクを別の保護袋へ入れて、冊子と一緒の封筒にします。内容は二つとしてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保護袋へ移し冊子とディスクを二内容として申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put the disc in a separate protective pouch and place it in the same envelope as the booklet. I will declare them as two items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move the disc to a protective pouch and declare the booklet and disc as two items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの封筒で厚さを測れます。急ぎのお届けでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can measure the thickness using this envelope. Does it need to arrive urgently?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 急ぎではありません。使える方法の中から、料金を聞いて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急ぎでなく利用可方法の料金比較を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is not urgent. I would like to hear the prices of the available methods and then choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is not urgent and you want to compare prices for the available methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この形の大きさと内容なら、こちらの方法をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: For these dimensions and contents, we can offer this method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内された方法にします。ディスクを含む状態で量ってもらったので、封を閉じて差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容込み計量後の方法を選び封緘発送を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the method you explained. Since you have weighed it with the disc included, I will seal it and hand it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the method after weighing with all contents, and decide to seal and send it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらで受付します。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will accept it here. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの小切手についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the cheque you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の代金として受け取りました。現金で持ち帰るより、自分の口座へ入れる方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事代金小切手を本人口座へ入れる方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received it as payment for work. Rather than taking cash home, I would like to know how to deposit it into my own account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to deposit a cheque received as payment for work into your own account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小切手の記載と口座を、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member in charge will check the details on the cheque and your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらが小切手で、口座はこの通帳です。小切手を受け取るのは初めてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小切手通帳の提示と初受取りを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the cheque, and this is the passbook for my account. This is the first time I have received a cheque.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the cheque and passbook and say this is your first time receiving a cheque. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取立ての方法と、入金されるまでの日数をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the collection procedure and how many days it takes for the funds to be credited.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日口座へ入ると考えて支払先へ約束する前に、使える時期を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他支払いの約束前に資金利用可能時期を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before promising someone a payment on the assumption that it will reach my account today, I would like to ask when I can use the money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check when the funds will be available before promising another payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当から、その点と費用をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member in charge will explain that and the fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額は五万円です。差し引かれる費用があれば、口座へ入る金額も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五万円と費用控除後の入金額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The amount is 50,000 yen. If any fees are deducted, I would also like to check how much will be credited to my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the amount, 50,000 yen, and ask how much will be credited after fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小切手をお預かりする場合の控えもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also explain the receipt provided if we take the cheque for collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いてからお願いし、預けたことが分かる控えを受け取ります。仕事の記録には受取日と入金日を分けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後の依頼控えと受取日入金日の記録を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask you to proceed after hearing the explanation and receive a receipt showing that I handed it over. In my work records, I will record the date I received the cheque separately from the date the money is credited.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss proceeding after the explanation, obtaining a receipt, and recording the receipt and credit dates separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、小切手と通帳を担当へお持ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the cheque and passbook to the staff member in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for nori seaweed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手巻きずし用です。この味付きと焼き海苔の袋では、味以外に大きさも違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手巻き用味付けと焼き海苔のサイズ差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for hand-rolled sushi. Do these packets of seasoned nori and toasted nori differ in size as well as flavor?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the size difference between seasoned and toasted nori for hand-rolled sushi. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 味付きは小さく切ってあり、焼き海苔はこちらの一枚の形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The seasoned nori is cut into small pieces, while the toasted nori comes in these whole sheets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 具を包むので、一枚の方を選びたいです。自分で半分に切れば使えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大判を選び半分に切る用途を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to wrap the fillings, so I would like the whole sheets. I can cut them in half myself to use them, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the large sheets and explain that you will cut them in half. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 枚数は袋の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the number of sheets on the packet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十枚入りです。半分なら二十枚にできるので、四人で使う量を考えやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十枚を半分にした数と四人の量を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are ten sheets. Halving them would give me twenty pieces, so it is easier to plan how much four people will use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the number obtained by halving ten sheets and the amount for four people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ大きさで、五枚入りもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also have packets of five sheets in the same size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は十枚にします。余った分をしまえる袋か、裏の保存表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十枚選択と残りの保存表示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take ten today. I would like to check the storage instructions on the back and whether the packet can hold the leftovers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose ten sheets and ask to check the instructions for storing the rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに保存の案内と、口の閉じ方があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are the storage instructions and how to close the opening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を読みました。味付きの小片ではなく、大きい焼き海苔十枚を一袋買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を読み大判焼き海苔十枚一袋を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the label. I will buy one packet of ten large sheets of toasted nori, rather than small seasoned pieces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After reading the label, confirm one packet of ten large sheets of toasted nori. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらですね。お会計へどうぞ。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This one, then. Please go to the checkout. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落ち葉掃除の体験にご参加ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are joining the fallen-leaf cleanup activity, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。熊手とほうきが置いてありますが、芝生の上ではどちらを使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 芝生落葉掃除の道具選択を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There are rakes and brooms here. Which should I use on the lawn?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which tool to use for clearing fallen leaves from the lawn. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの熊手を使います。力を入れすぎず、葉を寄せる動きをお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Use this rake. I will show you how to gather the leaves without applying too much force.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見本を見たいです。土まで引いてしまわないよう、先を軽く動かすのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 熊手実演を見て軽い操作を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to see a demonstration. So I move the tips lightly to avoid pulling up the soil as well, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Watch the rake demonstration and confirm the light movement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この辺りの葉を、通路側へ寄せてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Try gathering the leaves around here toward the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 軽く引くと葉が集まりました。集めた山は、このまま職員の方へ渡せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 落葉を寄せ終え集積物の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pulling lightly gathered the leaves. Should I hand this pile over to a staff member as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have gathered the leaves and ask what to do with the pile. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの袋へ入れます。枝が混じっていたら別のかごに分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Put them into this bag. If there are any branches mixed in, separate them into the other basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この短い枝をかごへ入れ、葉だけ袋にします。袋の口は閉じず、担当が集める場所へ運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 枝とか葉の分別袋かご搬送を実施する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put this short branch in the basket and only the leaves in the bag. I will leave the bag open and carry it to the staff's collection point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate branches and leaves into the basket and bag, and carry them over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方法でお願いします。熊手は終わったら返却台へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. When you finish, put the rake on the return stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 葉の袋とかごを指定場所へ置きました。熊手を返したので、次の参加者へ渡せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 集積物設置と熊手返却の完了を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have placed the bag of leaves and the basket at the designated spot. I have returned the rake, so it is ready for the next participant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that the collected materials are in place and the rake has been returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございました。それでは、体験はここで終了です。お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your help. That concludes the activity. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符はお受け取りになりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切符はありますが、出張の領収書を出すボタンを押し忘れました。今から発行できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 券売機購入後の領収書発行を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the ticket, but I forgot to press the receipt button for my business trip. Can you issue a receipt now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a receipt after purchasing a ticket at the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入した券売機と、お支払い方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me which ticket machine you used and how you paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左端の券売機で、現金で買いました。購入は五分ほど前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入機と現金と五分前を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bought it with cash at the machine on the far left. That was about five minutes ago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the machine used, the cash payment, and that it was five minutes ago. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの窓口で切符を確認して発行します。区間が見えるようにお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the ticket and issue a receipt at this counter. Please show it with the journey details visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どうぞ。会社名を入れたいのですが、宛名も書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符を示し会社名の宛名を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here you are. I would like my company name on it. Could you fill in the addressee too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and request the company name as the addressee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会社名をこの紙にお書きください。金額は切符の運賃になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write the company name on this paper. The amount will be the fare shown on the ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「青空工業株式会社」です。略さず、この名前でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社名の正式表記を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is “Aozora Kogyo Kabushiki Kaisha.” Please use this full name without abbreviating it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the full official company name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発行しました。宛名と区間をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is your receipt. Please check the addressee and the journey details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: どちらも合っています。領収書は書類入れにしまい、切符だけ改札で使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名区間を確認し領収書と切符を収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both are correct. I will put the receipt in my document holder and use only the ticket at the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the addressee and journey details, and put away the receipt and ticket appropriately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お渡しする物は以上です。出張、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is everything to hand over. Have a safe business trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広報紙をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the community newsletter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年の夏に載った地域のお祭りの記事を読みたいです。古い号は見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前年夏の広報記事閲覧を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to read an article about a local festival published last summer. Can I see old issues?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to view a newsletter article from the previous summer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 閲覧用の綴りがあります。七月と八月、どちらの記事でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have bound copies for reading here. Was the article in July or August?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 月を覚えていません。写真に大きな太鼓が写っていたので、その写真を目印に探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 月不明と太鼓の写真を手掛かりにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not remember the month. The photograph showed a large drum, so I would like to look for it using that picture as a clue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the month is unknown and use the drum photograph as a clue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この二冊を閲覧席でご覧ください。持ち帰り用はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look through these two volumes at the reading seats. There are no copies to take home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで読みます。見つけた記事の発行日をメモしたいので、筆記用具を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 閲覧席利用と筆記具借用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will read them here. Could I borrow something to write with so I can note the publication date of the article I find?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to use the reading area and borrow a writing tool. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鉛筆をお貸しします。発行日は表紙にもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can lend you a pencil. The publication date is also on the cover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 八月号にありました。記事のページと発行日を控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 八月号の記事ページと発行日を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I found it in the August issue. I will note the article's page and publication date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the page and publication date of the article in the August issue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 閲覧を終えましたら、綴りはこの机へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you finish reading, please return the bound copies to this desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモできました。二冊と鉛筆をここへ返します。写真で思い出せてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二冊と鉛筆を返却し閲覧を終える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have made my notes. I will return both volumes and the pencil here. I am glad the photograph helped me remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the two volumes and pencil, and finish reading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお返しいただきました。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Everything has been returned. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 採血が終わりました。この綿を押さえてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: The blood draw is finished. Please press down on this cotton pad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袖がきついので、今は腕を曲げずに押さえています。いつ袖を下ろしてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: きつい袖と下ろす時期を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My sleeve is tight, so I am pressing without bending my arm for now. When can I pull my sleeve down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention the tight sleeve and ask when to lower it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず腕を伸ばしたまま圧迫してください。血が止まったか私が見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, keep pressure on it with your arm straight. I will check whether the bleeding has stopped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このまま待ちます。血をさらさらにする薬を飲んでいることも伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 圧迫継続と服薬を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will wait like this. I should also tell you that I take medicine to thin my blood.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will continue applying pressure and disclose your medication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。薬の名前を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for telling me. Can we check the name of the medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お薬手帳に載っています。このページの薬を今朝飲みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手帳の薬と今朝の服用を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is in my medication record. I took the medicine on this page this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the medication in your record and say you took it this morning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手帳を確認しました。圧迫を続けた後、もう一度見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have checked the record. Keep applying pressure, then let me have another look.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ綿に少し血が付きます。押さえる場所は針を抜いたここで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 綿の出血と圧迫位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is still a little blood on the cotton. Am I pressing the right spot here, where the needle was removed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention blood on the cotton and check where to apply pressure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、そこです。今確認すると止まっています。袖は締め付けないようゆっくり戻しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, there. On checking now, the bleeding has stopped. Let us lower your sleeve slowly so that it does not constrict your arm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出血が止まったと分かりました。袖をゆっくり下ろし、また血が出たらすぐ声を掛けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 止血確認後に袖を戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand that the bleeding has stopped. I will lower the sleeve slowly and let you know immediately if it starts bleeding again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will lower your sleeve after the bleeding has been confirmed to have stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それで結構です。お大事になさってください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車についてのご質問ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about your bicycle, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中古で買った自転車です。防犯登録のシールが読みにくいのですが、登録の相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中古車の読みにくい防犯シールの相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought this bicycle secondhand. The anti-theft registration sticker is hard to read, and I would like to know whom to consult about its registration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult about the illegible anti-theft sticker on a secondhand bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入したお店はありますか。それとも個人から譲り受けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you buy it at a shop, or did an individual give it to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近所の自転車店で買い、領収書はあります。前の所有者については店から説明を聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店舗購入と領収書所持を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I bought it at a bicycle shop nearby and have the receipt. The shop did not explain anything about the previous owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the shop purchase and that you have the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 登録を扱う店に、所有者変更と必要な書類を確認してください。ここではシールだけで完了とは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ask a shop that handles registrations about changing the owner and the documents needed. We cannot judge from the sticker alone whether registration is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買った店へ相談します。車体番号は、シールの番号とは別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入店相談と車体番号の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will consult the shop where I bought it. Is the frame number different from the number on the sticker?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will consult the seller and ask how the frame number differs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。車体に刻まれた番号です。場所は自転車の種類によって異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. It is the number stamped on the frame. Its location varies depending on the type of bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では店で場所も見せてもらいます。領収書と自転車を持って行けば、話を始められますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車体番号を店で見せてもらう準備を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will ask the shop to show me where it is too. If I bring the receipt and bicycle, that should let us start the discussion, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your preparations to have the shop show you the frame number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入状況を説明する資料として役立ちます。必要書類の追加は店で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Those will help explain the purchase circumstances. Please ask the shop whether any additional documents are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 中古購入と読みにくいシールを伝え、登録の状態と書類を店で確認します。相談先が分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入状況と登録書類を店へ確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell the shop that it was bought secondhand and the sticker is difficult to read, then check the registration status and required documents. Now I know whom to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the purchase circumstances, registration, and documents with the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご購入のお店へお尋ねください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please ask the shop where you bought it. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお手紙をお出しになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。封筒の糊が乾いて、口が開いています。ここで糊を借りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 糊が乾いた封筒の封緘用に糊を借りる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The glue on the envelope has dried and the flap is open. Could I borrow some glue here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Borrow glue to seal an envelope whose adhesive has dried. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記入台にあります。厚みのある物は入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is some on the writing desk. Does the envelope contain anything thick?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真を二枚入れています。折り目を付けず、封筒の口だけ閉じたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真二枚と折らず封緘したい希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are two photographs inside. I want to close only the flap without creasing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the two photographs and your wish to seal the envelope without folding them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身が糊に触れないよう、端まで奥へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please push the contents all the way in so that they do not touch the glue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥へ入れました。貼った部分を押さえるため、この台を少し使ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身を奥へ入れ台の使用を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have pushed them in. May I use this counter for a moment to press down the glued part?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have pushed the contents in and ask to use the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。閉じ終わりましたら、窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. When you have finished sealing it, please bring it to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 閉じました。角も浮いていません。重さを量って料金を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封緘後の角を確認し料金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is sealed now, and the corners are not lifting either. Please weigh it and tell me the postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the corners after sealing and ask the postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この封筒は百十円です。切手はまだ貼ってありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This envelope costs 110 yen. There is no stamp on it yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 百十円を払います。糊を元の場所へ戻したので、この封筒の発送をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金を払い糊返却と発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pay 110 yen. I have put the glue back where it belongs, so please send this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay the postage, say you returned the glue, and request mailing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。お手紙をお預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27225-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will take your letter. Thank you.
